title: White Hexagon Kitchen Backsplash
summary: Kitchen update featuring a white hexagon backsplash installed around the range and microwave with clean cuts and a bright neutral finish.
problem: The range wall needed a finished backsplash surface that would coordinate with white cabinets, stainless appliances and the existing granite countertops.
solution: Installed white hexagon tile behind the range and microwave, completing the layout around cabinets, counter edges and electrical components.
